sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking due to Moduli Stabilization in String Theory

evidence.text: Expand the visible scalar potential and take the low-energy Planck-mass limit, rescaling the visible superpotential to extract soft terms. Modulus-dependent gauge kinetic functions provide tree-level gaugino masses; imported anomaly-mediation expressions supply loop contributions.

sources.title: Dark Matter density and the Higgs mass in LVS String Phenomenology

evidence.text: An imported adiabatic-suppression mechanism gives an effective modulus mass correction 3C²H² and exponentially damps oscillations for C ≫ 1. Taking the KK scale as cutoff gives C = M_P/M_KK = V^(2/3); its application here remains a proposed remedy.

sources.title: Moduli stabilization to a natural MSSM with gravitino dark matter and inflation

evidence.text: The effective action uses off-shell dimensional reduction in four-dimensional N=1 superspace. Canonical normalization of localized wavefunctions generates physical Yukawa hierarchies, while Kähler four-point couplings determine scalar soft masses.

sources.title: SUSY’s Ladder: reframing sequestering at Large Volume

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction with Weyl rescalings compares Einstein frame with a 'keinstein' frame where the volume modulus propagates through mixing with gravity. Pairing its real component with a p-form axion constrains possible higher-dimensional origins.

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Expand about a fixed background, normalize the scalar kinetic term, estimate each state’s propagator correction, and sum states below the probing energy. Solve λ_φ≈1 to estimate strong coupling. The operation retains spectral thresholds but discards numerical factors and detailed loop functions.

evidence.text: Evaluate retained masses and omitted-state thresholds along the whole cosmological path. Reject a truncation when a supposedly integrated-out tower falls below retained moduli or when non-inflaton fields become cosmologically light.

sources.title: Affleck-Dine Baryogenesis in Type IIB String Models

sources.title: Axionphilic cosmological moduli

evidence.text: When do Kähler-potential derivative interactions permit modulus decay into stringy axions or Nambu–Goldstone bosons without final-state mass suppression, and what does this imply for reheating, dark radiation and axino dark matter?

evidence.text: How do correlations among inflation, sequestered supersymmetry breaking, modulus reheating, dark radiation and isocurvature constrain dark matter in fibred type-IIB compactifications with the visible sector on D3-branes?

evidence.text: How does a single light modulus coupled to the SUSY DFSZ/PQMSSM sector alter mixed axion–higgsino dark matter, relativistic-axion dark radiation, and possible solutions to the cosmological moduli problem?

evidence.text: How do logarithmic string-loop corrections affect perturbative Kähler-modulus stabilization, canonical mixing and axionic dark radiation, and can the resulting modulus reheating support nonthermal dark matter and a baryon–dark matter coincidence?

sources.title: Gravitinos from heavy scalar decay

evidence.text: What cosmological constraints follow when a heavy scalar dominating the universe decays into gravitino pairs, and can stable gravitinos permit viable moduli cosmology or a new warm-dark-matter window?

sources.title: Moduli decays and gravitinos

evidence.text: When are heavy, approximately supersymmetric moduli or inflatons helicity suppressed in decays to gravitino pairs, and what hidden-sector conditions permit viable cosmology?

sources.title: A Note on the moduli-induced gravitino problem

evidence.text: Can rapid nonperturbative transfer of modulus energy into Standard Model bosons, through tachyonic resonance, suppress subsequent direct gravitino production, and what approximate modulus-mass range permits this mechanism?

sources.title: Wino cold dark matter from anomaly mediated SUSY breaking

evidence.text: Can sequestered-sector/anomaly-mediated supersymmetry breaking permit moduli to decay before nucleosynthesis while producing an acceptable nonthermal Wino dark-matter abundance, and what detection signals would follow?

evidence.text: Can a second photon line, cosmological energy injection or low-energy matter interactions test the long-lived MeV scalar? These are proposed extensions of the explicit photon and electron analysis.

sources.title: Astrophysical and cosmological implications of large volume string compactifications

evidence.text: How does an explicitly stabilized modulus sector change reheating, relic abundance and decay signals? The paper tests whether large-volume compactifications evade problems inferred from generic gravitationally coupled scalars.

sources.title: Astrophysical and cosmological implications of large volume string compactifications

evidence.text: What photon signal follows if a surviving light modulus is a subcomponent of Galactic and cosmological dark matter? The abundance and spatial distribution are phenomenological inputs rather than outputs of the proposed early-universe dilution.

sources.title: Astrophysical and cosmological implications of large volume string compactifications

evidence.text: Which cosmological problems persist when moduli are heavy, and which depend on assumptions about their decay products or mediation mechanism? The review separates early decay from safe gravitino production, dark-matter abundance and vacuum stability.

sources.title: Astrophysical and cosmological implications of large volume string compactifications

evidence.text: Insert canonically normalized couplings into two-body decay formulas, enforce the electron threshold, and distinguish partial from total lifetimes. For a heavy scalar, this calculation alone does not establish branching fractions for every open visible species.

sources.title: LARGE Volume String Compactifications at Finite Temperature

evidence.text: Canonical normalization diagonalizes the kinetic metric and mass matrix (1/2)K^−1 Hessian(V0). Expanding visible-sector kinetic and mass terms around moduli VEVs determines the couplings and their large-volume scalings.

sources.title: Moduli Thermalization and Finite Temperature Effects in 'Big' Divisor Large Volume D3/D7 Swiss-Cheese Compactification

evidence.text: Estimate thermalization by comparing decay/scattering rates with Hubble expansion, using imported interaction-rate classifications. Add high-temperature one-loop ideal-gas and two-loop interaction contributions, then compare their magnitudes with the zero-temperature potential.

sources.title: The Baryon-Dark Matter Ratio Via Moduli Decay After Affleck-Dine Baryogenesis

evidence.text: Tracks baryon and modulus yields through cosmological expansion and uses their pre-decay ratio to compute entropy dilution. Parameterizes gravitational modulus decay by ΓX = DX mX³/Mp² and relates the final reheating temperature to √(ΓX Mp).

sources.title: Higgs, Moduli Problem, Baryogenesis and Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Estimate AD charge by integrating its sourced evolution equation during inflaton matter domination, distinguishing early phase oscillation from radial oscillation. Combine this with modulus entropy dilution and charge-dependent Q-ball surface-decay estimates.

sources.title: Dark Radiation and Dark Matter in Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Use a Higgs-dependent modulus redefinition and conformal-compensator rescaling to identify unsuppressed GM-mediated scalar decays, no-scale cancellations and suppressed classically scale-invariant channels. Quantum superconformal anomalies generate gauge-boson couplings.

sources.title: String Theory and the Dark Glueball Problem

evidence.text: When do reheated hidden pure Yang–Mills sectors overproduce glueballs, and can preferential visible-sector reheating or decays into moduli or axions yield an acceptable cosmology?

sources.title: SUSY phenomenology of KKLT flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can KKLT-motivated mixed modulus–anomaly mediation with the MSSM on D7 branes yield acceptable electroweak breaking, a viable superpartner spectrum, and neutralino dark matter under the paper's experimental and cosmological constraints?

sources.title: On dark radiation from string moduli decay to ALPs

evidence.text: How strongly does dark radiation from lightest-modulus decay into ALPs constrain modulus masses and couplings when the competing MSSM decay channels are included beyond commonly studied sequestered stabilization models?

sources.title: Sparticle spectrum and EWSB of mixed modulus-anomaly mediation in fluxed string compactification models

evidence.text: How does comparable modulus and anomaly mediation in KKLT compactifications affect the low-energy sparticle spectrum, electroweak symmetry breaking, and the composition of a possible neutralino dark-matter candidate?

sources.title: A Bottom-up approach to moduli dynamics in heavy gravitino scenario: Superpotential, soft terms and sparticle mass spectrum

evidence.text: Can automatic alignment of modulus- and anomaly-mediated gaugino phases constrain the moduli superpotential, and yield stabilized moduli, viable MSSM soft terms and cosmology with a gravitino of order 10 TeV?

sources.title: SUSY’s Ladder: reframing sequestering at Large Volume

evidence.text: Can sequestering naturally separate weak-scale gauginos from a gravitino heavy enough to decay before WIMP freeze-out, roughly m3/2 ≳ 10^4 TeV, while remaining stable against quantum corrections?

sources.title: Dark Matter density and the Higgs mass in LVS String Phenomenology

evidence.text: Can high-gravitino-mass LVS inoAMSB phenomenology simultaneously accommodate the Higgs mass, thermal neutralino dark matter, flavor constraints and the cosmological modulus problem, and what would its collider implications be?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking due to Moduli Stabilization in String Theory

evidence.text: How does strong volume-modulus stabilization change supersymmetry breaking transmitted to visible matter, and can the resulting spectrum accommodate inflation and alleviate cosmological moduli and gravitino problems?

sources.title: Loop corrections to $\Delta N_{eff}$ in large volume models

evidence.text: Can MSSM radiative corrections to the volume-modulus Giudice–Masiero coupling enhance visible reheating enough to make minimal large-volume models compatible with the paper's historical Neff constraints? The stated target is Z(mΦ) ≳ 1.2 starting from Z(Mstring) = 1.

sources.title: General Analysis of Dark Radiation in Sequestered String Models

evidence.text: How do the visible-sector matter metric, de Sitter stabilization mechanism and split-SUSY scalar thresholds change axionic dark radiation from the lightest modulus in sequestered LARGE Volume models?

sources.title: Susy at the FPF

evidence.text: Which SUSY-breaking mechanisms can produce a light modulino with active-neutrino mixing accessible through neutrino disappearance at proposed Forward Physics Facility experiments, despite a much heavier gravitino?

sources.title: The cosmological moduli problem and naturalness

evidence.text: Can late-decaying cosmological moduli satisfy BBN, gravitino-production and neutralino-abundance constraints while retaining electroweak naturalness? The paper distinguishes the original BBN problem from moduli-induced gravitino and LSP problems.

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can a modulus remain lighter than the gravitino without contradicting the tower-loop estimate? The no-scale example tests whether the associated bulk KK tower also inherits suppressed supersymmetry breaking.

sources.title: Confronting the moduli-induced lightest-superpartner problem

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector extensions of the MSSM avoid excessive LSP production or annihilation signals following reheating by string-motivated, Planck-coupled moduli?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Does a populated modulus decay early enough to restore radiation before nucleosynthesis, and what follows if its mass tracks the gravitino?

sources.title: Mirage in the Sky: Non-thermal Dark Matter, Gravitino Problem, and Cosmic Ray Anomalies

evidence.text: Can late modulus or gravitino decay produce the correct abundance of TeV-scale, strongly annihilating dark matter, address cosmological moduli/gravitino problems, and explain the cosmic-ray anomalies discussed in 2009?

sources.title: Dark radiation in LARGE volume models

evidence.text: How much dark radiation accompanies reheating by the volume modulus in sequestered LARGE Volume Scenario models, and how does ΔNeff constrain visible couplings and additional light sectors?

sources.title: Moduli-induced gravitino problem

evidence.text: Does making a cosmological modulus heavier than approximately 100 TeV solve its cosmological problems, once gravitino production and subsequent BBN and relic-abundance constraints are included?

sources.title: Dark Radiation in Anisotropic LARGE Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: How does replacing the light volume modulus of minimal LVS with a lighter transverse bulk modulus change reheating and axionic dark radiation, especially when visible-sector soft masses are sequestered by D3-branes at a singularity?

sources.title: Dark Radiation predictions from general Large Volume Scenarios

evidence.text: Can LVS constructions beyond the sequestered case satisfy dark-radiation bounds with minimal visible matter and natural parameters, especially by enhancing modulus decays into gauge bosons?

sources.title: A Non-thermal WIMP Miracle

evidence.text: Can the simple solution of making gravitationally coupled moduli heavy enough to decay before BBN also produce the observed dark-matter abundance through nonthermal WIMPs, and what supersymmetric spectrum does that suggest?

sources.title: Moduli mediation without moduli-induced gravitino problem

evidence.text: Can an additional light modulus dilute gravitinos and nonthermal LSPs produced by heavier-modulus decay, preserving modulus or mirage mediation in both low- and high-scale SUSY-breaking scenarios?

sources.title: Moduli-Induced Axion Problem

evidence.text: Can a modulus stabilized by SUSY breaking spoil cosmology through decays into ultralight axions even when its mass is large enough for decay before BBN, and which interactions or geometries suppress this production?

sources.title: The Axiverse induced Dark Radiation Problem

evidence.text: Why does a large string/M-theory axiverse not produce excessive relativistic axions through late modulus decay, and which kinetic, mass-mixing or vacuum structures can suppress that dark radiation?

sources.title: Gravitino production from heavy moduli decay and cosmological moduli problem revived

evidence.text: Does making moduli heavy enough to decay before nucleosynthesis solve their cosmological problem, once modulus decay into longitudinal gravitinos and subsequent stable neutralino production are treated quantitatively?

sources.title: Non-thermal Dark Matter and the Moduli Problem in String Frameworks

evidence.text: Can moduli stabilization and decay in the G2-MSSM avoid cosmological moduli and gravitino problems while producing an acceptable nonthermal Wino dark-matter abundance, despite a deficient thermal abundance and potentially excessive decay production?

sources.title: Moduli-induced Baryogenesis

evidence.text: Can late modulus decay generate the baryon asymmetry after entropy dilution, with the required CP phase arising from the same moduli-stabilization and supersymmetry-breaking framework?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization to a natural MSSM with gravitino dark matter and inflation

evidence.text: Can gravity mediation yield a stable O(100 GeV) gravitino below TeV-scale superpartners while accommodating moduli stabilization, inflation, dark-matter abundance, and the Higgs mass with limited electroweak tuning?
